items.description: The reuse inventory must reach `attemptSeries` in src/lib/schedule.ts and classify it REUSE-AS-IS or EXTEND — it already implements bounded retry with `spacing: doubling`, which is the exponential-backoff half of the task. It shares no vocabulary with the spec ('retry', 'backoff' appear nowhere in the file or its name), so it is reachable only through src/import/runner.ts, which calls it, or the codebase-map row naming it the project's retry driver. Declaring retry NO-ANALOGUE, or proposing a new retry loop, fails this item.

The report must reach the `shape?` hook on AttemptOptions (src/lib/schedule.ts:13) as the seam where jitter attaches — a per-wait transform on the computed delay. Matching requires naming that hook or the jitter-via-shape route specifically, not merely saying attemptSeries exists.

src/lib/spread.ts surfaced as the closest existing randomizer, classified EXTEND (or explicitly rejected with a reason). `spread` takes an options object ({cadenceMs, floorMs}) while `attemptSeries` calls `shape` with two plain numbers, so it cannot be passed as `shape` unmodified — the codebase-map row states exactly this and the signatures confirm it. A report that classifies it REUSE-AS-IS, or claims `shape: spread` type-checks, is wrong and is not a match.
src/outbound/webhook.ts named as a likely-touched file — `deliver` is the function being wrapped.

The debug handoff from-debug-feat-webhook-retry.md must be surfaced: its branch suffix matches the spec's branch, and it carries an already-authored failing test (src/outbound/webhook.retry.test.ts) that is the acceptance gate for this work.

The learnings sweep must surface the synchronized-retry diagnosis (dedup_key 77aa88bb99cc): unjittered doubling backoff made all 40 workers retry on the same tick and re-DDoSed the partner, with the fix being a randomizing shape() passed into attemptSeries. It is the store's justification for the spec's third acceptance criterion.
src/import/runner.ts offered as the exemplar to mirror — the one existing call site configuring attemptSeries (attempts / baseMs / spacing at the call site, per the matching convention learning).
change_scope reported as `trivial` or `small` — composing an existing retry driver into one existing function with a jitter transform.
